name: Long-term user activity evaluator (journey state)
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage shows a visible 'Your next move' banner for authenticated users
Banner states a stage label (one of: discovering, profile building, essay drafting, essay polishing, interview practice) via its heading/title
Banner renders 1-3 next-action CTA buttons with arrow icons
CTAs are visually distinct — the first action is the primary (filled) button
Banner color/gradient is stage-appropriate (not pure white/black — has a tinted gradient background)
Banner is positioned above the 'Continue where you left off' strip and above 'Daily Missions'
antiPatterns: Banner visible when signed out (should be hidden)
CTA href values are '#' or empty
Stage title overlaps other nav/hero text

screenshots.expect: Full homepage with JourneyBanner visible in its mounted position; the banner shows state title, message, and CTAs
